points.statement: The model should dynamically assemble restoration parameters conditioned on the input image and apply them at the token level.
points.quote: Instead of selecting from a static set of experts or modulating the network with a single global condition, the model should dynamically assemble restoration parameters conditioned on the input image and apply them at the token level.

points.statement: The formulation is well suited to compositional degradations, where different spatial tokens can receive different residual updates while sharing a compact, efficient input-conditioned parameter space.
points.quote: This formulation is particularly suitable for compositional degradations, where different spatial tokens can receive different residual updates while sharing a compact and efficient input-conditioned parameter space.

points.statement: Instead of pooling intermediate features into one global descriptor, the adapter uses learnable queries to probe condensed spatial contexts and decode them into routing bases and residual directions.
points.quote: Rather than pooling intermediate features into a single global descriptor, the adapter uses learnable queries to probe condensed spatial contexts and decode them into routing bases and residual directions.

points.statement: Assembled residual updates are injected into the restoration backbone's attention projections, allowing spatial feature interactions to adapt to each image's degradation structure.
points.quote: The assembled residual updates are injected into the attention projections of the restoration backbone, allowing spatial feature interactions to adapt to the degradation structure of each image.

points.statement: Every spatial token assembles its own additive residual update via dense signed dot-product affinities over the generated rank-wise components.
points.quote: Each spatial token then assembles its own additive residual update through dense signed dot-product affinities over these generated rank-wise components.

points.statement: The token-wise residual can be expressed as a dot-product interaction between spatial tokens and dynamically synthesized routing bases, then a weighted combination of synthesized residual directions.
points.quote: The token-wise residual can be written as a dot-product interaction between spatial tokens and dynamically synthesized routing bases, followed by a weighted combination of synthesized residual directions.

points.statement: Spatial tokens act as queries, while generated routing bases and residual directions play roles analogous to keys and values.
points.quote: In this form, spatial tokens serve as queries, while the generated routing bases and residual directions play roles analogous to keys and values.
